candidate.eligibility: strict C[d-1]>C[d-29] on completed UTC daily closes
candidate.R2: log(C[d-1]/C[d-29])/(std(ddof1) of 28 completed log daily returns * sqrt28)
candidate.selection: only when all3 eligible choose top2; lexicographic ties; undefined slot left cash
candidate.review: daily decision no earlier than00:00:05 UTC, execution01:00 UTC

historical.source: official Bybit v5 spot kline interval60 only
historical.availability: probe first/last/warmup for each coin; fetch only bounded 3*18264 hourly bars if all probes available; <=72 requests, <=20MiB total; gaps stop whole historical experiment, never substitute venue or subset
historical.accounting: continuous two-year cash, initialcash once, no January2023 reset;01:00open;terminal2023-12-31 23:00open; fees, minimums and retained dust; separate annual attribution
historical.constraints: C5 and parent current spot precision MODELED historically; not historical acceptance proof
comparators: persistent random with same eligible pool and R2 switch calendar
historical.interpretation: retrospective temporal extension, NOT prospective OOS; all results including negative retained
historical.passes: both years and BASE/STRESS net and incremental returns positive, MDD<=30%, paired CI positive; otherwise no historical validation claim

forward.late_start: if setup completes after start, freeze new next future UTC day before forward observations; never backfill missed decisions; six calendar months from actual start
forward.launch: publish protocol and pass functional public-data checks before daemon; use suitable existing VPS if actually accessible, else transparent local hidden process with availability caveat; no Docker, no account or trading core
forward.control_samples: before forward start CONTROLS_ONLY, not forward profit observations
forward.signal_history: fetch latest29 completed UTC daily bars, continuous; forbid any 2026-01-01..2026-09-30 market-price requests; request window after2026-10-01 only for livewarmup
forward.availability: save source event/end and server timestamp, HTTP request started/finished UTC, monotonic latency, ingested_at, raw bytes SHA256; do not label modeled availability as observed
forward.decision: collect after00:00:05; source final day must be yesterday, all3 complete;5min deadline else missed
forward.execution: collect all three public orderbook50 + instruments-info at01:00, max60s late, maxbook age5s and intersymbol skew5s; failure rejects whole scheduled account step; no backdated fills
forward.books: strictly ordered positive bids/asks and noncrossed BBO; server-time freshness; sweep depth independently per virtual account; insufficient requested depth rejects leg; no actual orders or guaranteed fill claim
forward.accounting: independent BASELINE/R2 *3 capitals*2 costs*2 execution assumptions; shared no-borrowing execution functions

paths.MODEL_C5: observed midpoint reference with frozen C5 precision and +/-2/5bp buffer; modeled fills only
paths.OBSERVED_BOOK: current observed spot limits/precision/status and available depth; quote budget buy, base quantity sell, buy fee acquired base and sell fee quote; sweep-book VWAP plus same2/5bp adverse buffer; quote snapshot estimate not proof

forward.marking: daily decision and execution snapshot bid/ask mid; unresolved data => unvalued/partial rather than carry convenient prices; balances preserved; mark-to-market vs fee/minimum-aware liquidatable cash/dust separately
forward.persistence: append-only raw receipts and event ledger; atomically checkpoint balances and processed decision/execution ids; restart idempotent; missed slots explicitly recorded, no replay into earlier time
forward.risk: MDD>30% permanently disqualifies real capital for that observation run, observer may continue research; no automatic liquidation/parameter changes
forward.minimum_observation: no confirmation before six complete calendar months and full data-quality review; early results provisional

random.method: persistent random omitted coin when all3 eligible. At known current R2 omitted-leader change, force random omission to change uniformly to one of other2. Eligible-set transitions handled by same weights. No daily independent reshuffling. Same current R2 event schedule is known at decision, no future info.
random.comparison: report turnover normalized by pretrade NAV, switching count, exposure and costs; random comparisons meaningful only if >=90% of paths turnover within +/-20% of R2 and average exposure within2 percentage points; report all paths regardless, no selection by returns

statistics.primary: paired R2 minus same-engine BASELINE net whole-capital return; dollars and percentage points
statistics.inference: paired circular calendar blocks7/30 days,5000 resamples,seed6111502; CI daily mean paired netreturn difference and paired compounded-return delta; centered-null daily p; Holm across6 capital/cost comparisons per block; no independent-coin sampling
statistics.forward: minimum6calendar months, daily checkpoints; no parameter changes on interim results; baseline tests and risk thresholds frozen
statistics.leader_costs: all turnover, fee and buffer cost on both legs, reason-coded leader switches
statistics.three_eligible: report fraction of daily decisions with3 eligible
statistics.benchmarks: equal fixed-quantity buy/hold same fees/constraints; cash; random as above
statistics.capital_gate: NO AUTOMATIC LIVE GO; separately evaluated only if positive BASE/STRESS incremental and net, MDD<=30%, data/execution audit pass and bothblock corrected tests pass; historical result alone never authorizes real capital
